# Additions to Daniel Chapter 3 (Bel and the Dragon) — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Codex Vaticanus (Theodotion recension), Additions to Daniel 3 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-DC/ADD_003_page_001.jpg

---

*[Addition 3: Bel and the Dragon. Two episodes: (1) Daniel exposes the fraud of the idol Bel by strewing ashes on the floor and revealing the priests' footprints (vv. 1–22); (2) Daniel kills the "dragon" (a large serpent worshiped as divine) by feeding it an explosive concoction, and is then thrown into the lion's den — a second den experience (vv. 23–42).]*

**3:1** And King Astyages was-gathered to his fathers, and Cyrus the-Persian received the-kingdom.

**3:2** And Daniel was a companion of the-king and was honored above all his friends.

**3:3** Now the-Babylonians had an idol [whose name was] Bel, and there-was consumed for it each day twelve great measures of fine-flour and forty sheep and six jars of wine.

**3:4** And the-king honored it and went every day to-worship it; but Daniel worshiped his own God.

**3:5** And the-king said to him: "Why do-you not worship Bel?" And he-said: "Because I-worship-not idols made-with-hands, but the living God who-created heaven and earth and has dominion over all flesh."

**3:6** And the-king said to him: "Does-it not seem to you that Bel is a living god? Do-you-not see how-much he-eats and drinks every day?"

**3:7** And Daniel laughed and said: "Do-not be deceived, O king; for this [one] is clay inside and bronze outside, and it-has-never eaten nor drunk anything."

**3:8** And the-king was-enraged and called his priests and said to them: "If you-do-not tell me who it-is who eats up these-provisions, you-will-die.

**3:9** But if you-show that Bel eats them, Daniel-shall-die, who-blasphemed against Bel." And Daniel said to the-king: "Let it-be according to your word."

**3:10** Now the-priests of-Bel were seventy in number, apart-from wives and children. And the-king went with Daniel into the-temple of Bel.

**3:11** And the-priests of-Bel said: "Behold, we ourselves are-going-out; and you, O king, set-out the-food and mix the-wine and seal [the doors], and coming in early-in-the-morning, if you-do-not find that Bel has-eaten everything, we-will-die; otherwise Daniel-shall-die, who-has-lied against us."

**3:12** And they-were-not-concerned, because they-had made under the-table a hidden entrance, and through it they-always went-in and consumed everything.

**3:13** And it-happened after they-had-gone-out, the-king set-before Bel the-food. And Daniel commanded his servants and they-brought ashes and spread them over all the-temple before the-king alone; and having-gone-out, they-sealed the-door and went away.

**3:14** And in-the night the-priests came as-usual with their wives and children, and they-ate and drank everything.

**3:15** And the-king rose-up early-in-the-morning, and Daniel with him.

**3:16** And the-king said: "Daniel, are-the seals intact?" And he-said: "They-are intact, O king."

**3:17** And it-happened, as-soon-as the-doors were-opened, the-king looked at the-table and cried-out with a loud-voice: "You-are great, O Bel, and there-is no-deceit in you at-all!"

**3:18** And Daniel laughed and held-back the-king from going-in, and said: "Look at the-floor and recognize whose footprints these-are."

**3:19** And the-king said: "I-see the-footprints of men and women and children." And the-king was-enraged,

**3:20** and he-seized the-priests and their wives and children; and they-showed him the-hidden-doors through which they-used-to-enter and consume the-things on the-table.

**3:21** And the-king put-them-to-death and gave Bel into the-power of Daniel, who-overthrew it and its temple.

**3:22** And there-was in that place a great dragon, and the-Babylonians worshiped it.

**3:23** And the-king said to Daniel: "You-will-not-be-able to-say that this-one is not a living god; therefore worship it."

**3:24** And Daniel said: "I-will-worship the-Lord my God, for he is the living God.

**3:25** But give to me permission, O king, and I-will-kill the-dragon without sword and without staff." And the-king said: "I-give you permission."

**3:26** And Daniel took pitch and fat and hair, and cooked them together and made cakes, and put them into the-mouth of the-dragon. And the-dragon ate and burst-asunder. And Daniel said: "See the-things you-were worshiping!"

**3:27** And when the-Babylonians heard it, they-were very-indignant and conspired against the-king, saying: "The-king has-become a Jew; Bel he-has-destroyed and the-dragon he-has-killed and the-priests he-has-slaughtered."

**3:28** And having-come to the-king they-said: "Hand-over Daniel to us, or we-will-kill you and your house."

**3:29** And the-king saw that they-were-pressing heavily against him, and being-compelled by necessity he-handed-over Daniel to them.

**3:30** And they-threw him into the-den of-lions; and he-was there six days.

**3:31** And in the-den there-were seven lions, and two carcasses were-given to them each day and two sheep; but now they-were-not-given to them, in-order-that they-might-devour Daniel.

**3:32** And there-was Habakkuk the-prophet in Judea, and he-had cooked stew and had-crumbled bread in a bowl, and he-was-going into the-field to-bring it to the-reapers.

**3:33** And an angel of-the Lord said to Habakkuk: "Carry the-dinner which you-have to Babylon, to Daniel who-is in the-den of-lions."

**3:34** And Habakkuk said: "Lord, I-have-never-seen Babylon and I-do-not know the-den."

**3:35** And the-angel of-the Lord took him by the-top of his head and bore him by the-hair of his head, and with the-blast of his spirit he-set him in Babylon, above the-den.

**3:36** And Habakkuk cried-out, saying: "Daniel, Daniel, take the-dinner which God has-sent you."

**3:37** And Daniel said: "You-have-remembered me, O God, and you-have-not forsaken those-who-love you."

**3:38** And Daniel arose and ate. And the-angel of God immediately returned Habakkuk to his own place.

**3:39** And on the-seventh day the-king came to mourn for Daniel; and having-come to the-den he-looked in and behold — Daniel was-sitting there.

**3:40** And the-king cried-out with a loud-voice and said: "Great are you, O Lord God of Daniel, and there-is no-other besides you!"

**3:41** And he-drew him out, and those-who-had-sought his-destruction he-cast into the-den; and they-were devoured in-an-instant before him.

**3:42** Then the-king said: "Let all those-in the-whole world fear the-God of Daniel; for he is the-savior, working signs and wonders in-the earth, who-has-rescued Daniel from the-power of-the lions."
